title: Approximate tangent planes with multiplicity persist when μ is restricted to an open neighbourhood (parent Step 5)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N, let W ⊆ ℝ^N be open, x ∈ W, P ⊆ ℝ^N a linear subspace and θ ∈ ℝ. Suppose HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ holds: dim P = n, and (rⁿ)⁻¹∫ f(η_{x,r}(y)) dμ(y) → θ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) and Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n (μ⌞W) x P θ also holds, where μ⌞W is the restriction B ↦ μ(B ∩ W).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (θ : ℝ), IsOpen W → x ∈ W → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n (μ.restrict W) x P θ
